historical_regime: Carlos Andres Perez II (El Gran Viraje)
primary_mechanism: Price deregulation, gasoline subsidy cut, and public transit hikes trigger widespread social revolt and institutional crisis.
Military uprising by Hugo Chavez (MBR-200); political delegitimation despite strong macro rebound from 1989 trough.
Collapse of over half the commercial banking sector; bailout costs 11% of GDP; inflation accelerates to 103% by 1996.
Election of Hugo Chavez following collapse of international oil prices (<$11/bbl); transition to 1999 Constitution.
Acute political crisis, temporary ouster of Chavez, escalating social confrontation and strike mobilization.
Two-month general strike; dismissal of >18,000 experienced technical and operational staff; permanent field depletion hysteresis.
Succession of Maduro; beginning of global oil price decline; distortion of CADIVI/CENCOEX currency controls and onset of severe shortages.
EO 13808 financial and EO 13850 oil embargo; March 2019 blackouts solidify potlines; subsequent Chevron GL 41 recovery to ~850-950 kb/d.
